The 1969 King of Caracas Tournament was the 11th edition of the Small Club World Cup, a tournament held in Venezuela between 1952 and 1957, in certain years between 1963 and 1970, and in 1975. It was played as a round-robin tournament. It was organized and held in Venezuela.
